items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Tommy Dorsey in the context of Sy Oliver and Jimmy Lunceford, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal connection or anecdote regarding Tommy Dorsey.

ctx.x: And they'd say you know they'd be in them big hotels. They'd be playing these arrangements but it would be Jimmy Lunceford's stuff, you know.
That's right and were 'nt for Sy Oliver, where
would you think Tommy Dorsey would be? You see, they never talk about that.
